title: Add currency-safe grouping to dynamic customer receivable report
description: User scene: group the selected, scoped invoice and receipt-allocation evidence preview by customer or invoice month, with page subtotals split by original currency. Reuse ERP-117 authorized bounded rows; a group with unknown or over-allocated remaining evidence must visibly remain unknown rather than becoming a fake debt balance. Invalid group keys fail closed. Existing HTTP operation audit records read-only requests. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts only none/customer/month and derives deterministic customer-or-month plus currency page groups from the same authorized bounded preview rows; invalid group keys are rejected.
Page subtotals separate gross and effective allocations by currency, and label remaining as unknown if any row lacks known valid remaining evidence; designer labels totals as current-page only.
Tests cover mixed currencies, month boundaries, selected-field omission, unknown/over-allocated evidence, empty page and no writes; document page-subtotal semantics.
